channel.title: ALTRENDAT
channel.description: What the world is searching for, explained with sources

item.title: Portugal Snatches 4-2 Victory Over Denmark In Life After Cristiano Ronaldo
item.description: Portugal maintained their perfect Nations League start by defeating Denmark 4-2 in Copenhagen as Vitinha and Joao Felix secured late goals.

item.title: Kenya seeks redemption in Guinea after Eritrea stalemate
item.description: Kenya's national team faces Guinea on Thursday at 7 pm in Conakry, looking to recover from a 1-1 draw with Eritrea in their Africa Cup of Nations qualifying campaign.

item.title: Minimum wage surges in 5 provinces as pay rates climb nationwide
item.description: Ontario, Prince Edward Island, Nova Scotia, Manitoba and Saskatchewan hiked minimum hourly wages on October 1, 2026.

item.title: Emirates Airbus A380 diverts to Frankfurt after mid-air passenger medical emergency
item.description: Emirates flight EK31 from Dubai to London Heathrow made an emergency landing at Frankfurt Airport on Thursday after a passenger required medical attention.

item.title: Swift Telephone Network clinches licence to challenge Nigeria's telecom market giants
item.description: Swift Telephone Network Limited has secured a Unified Access Service Licence from the Nigerian Communications Commission to provide nationwide telecommunications services.

item.title: Public Protector finds Mashazi guilty of improper conduct over unqualified appointment
item.description: Former Ekurhuleni City Manager Imogen Mashazi was found guilty of improper conduct by Public Protector Kholeka Gcaleka on Thursday for appointing Ndumiso Gcwabe to a senior metro police role despite him lacking the required NQF level 7 qualification.

item.title: KFC jumps 30% bigger on chicken tenders after complaints of dry, scrawny rivals
item.description: KFC relaunched larger, crispier chicken tenders this week after a surge in complaints and lost sales to competitors, marking the first step in its biggest menu overhaul in decades.

item.title: Watson's 2-win streak ends reevaluation talk at Cleveland after 2-1 start
item.description: Deshaun Watson has led the Cleveland Browns to back-to-back victories following an opening loss, shifting the team's short-term plans away from week-to-week quarterback changes.

item.title: Crew-13 blasts off from Florida to reach the International Space Station
item.description: Four astronauts successfully launched on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from Kennedy Space Center at 11:10 a.m. Thursday.

item.title: Thulani Mabaso storms back with reserve team in dramatic Soweto Derby win
item.description: Kaizer Chiefs midfielder Thulani Mabaso returned to competitive action following a long-term injury during a 3-2 victory over Orlando Pirates.

item.title: Caitlin Clark signature shoe Caitlin 1s launch as Nike shares plunge 44%
item.description: Nike releases the new Caitlin 1 signature shoe on October 1 as the company faces declining revenue and a difficult financial year.

item.title: Pro Golfer Phil Mickelson Checks Into Treatment Center for Addiction and Trauma
item.description: Professional golfer Phil Mickelson voluntarily sought treatment for family trauma and addiction following recent misconduct allegations and personal health issues.

item.title: Sperm whale smashes yacht hull, forcing four sailors into desperate sea rescue
item.description: Four sailors were rescued after their 52-foot yacht, the Tai Tam, sank following a collision with a pod of sperm whales in the South Pacific.

item.title: Gears of War: E-Day Campaign Plunges Players Into Brutal Locust Invasion
item.description: The Coalition releases Gears of War: E-Day, a prequel set 14 years before the original game, featuring a campaign centered on Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago.

item.title: Malaysia Routs Singapore 6-0 to End Lions' FIFA ASEAN Cup Campaign
item.description: Singapore suffered a historic 6-0 defeat against Malaysia at the Si Jalak Harupat Stadium on October 1, eliminating the Lions from the FIFA ASEAN Cup.

item.title: SASSA Flags 169,000 Social Grant Beneficiaries for Potential Fraudulent Transactions
item.description: The South African Social Security Agency has flagged 169,000 beneficiaries for further investigation after they failed to appear for mandatory grant reviews.

item.title: Australia scraps credit card surcharges as banks slash rewards and hike fees
item.description: Starting October 1, Australia’s Reserve Bank has banned checkout surcharges on card payments, a move aimed at saving consumers $1.6 billion annually.

item.title: Four celebrity pairs race 7,500 km from Borneo to Melbourne Australia
item.description: The fourth series of the BAFTA-winning show features four new celebrity duos racing from Borneo to Melbourne on a strict daily budget.

item.title: Taran Armstrong Dagger Clinches 84-82 JackJumpers Thriller Over Melbourne United
item.description: Burnie-born Taran Armstrong drilled a game-winning jump shot with 5.5 seconds remaining to secure a two-point victory for the Tasmania JackJumpers on Thursday night.

item.title: Powerball Jackpot Surges to $60 Million After Draw 1585 Remains Untouched
item.description: The Division 1 prize remained unclaimed in Draw 1585 on October 1, forcing the jackpot to grow to $60 million for the next event.

item.title: Alexander Zverev Topples Cameron Norrie in Beijing After Missed Break Point Opportunity
item.description: Cameron Norrie exited the ATP Beijing Open in the first round following a defeat against Alexander Zverev.

item.title: Minister Poses Final Math Problem to Son Post-PSLE to Unlock Laptop
item.description: Following the conclusion of Singapore's Primary School Leaving Examination on September 30, Senior Minister of State Goh Pei Ming required his son to solve a math puzzle to regain laptop access.

item.title: Disruptive passenger triggers 2-hour delay, passengers applaud as woman exits Scoot flight
item.description: A woman was removed from Scoot flight TR905 in Macau on September 27 for disruptive behaviour, causing a two-hour delay before the plane departed for Singapore with 173 passengers.

item.title: Green ID book production ends March 31, 2027, then banned next year
item.description: South Africa's Home Affairs Minister announced the green ID book will stop being produced on March 31, 2027, and will no longer be valid identification from March 31, 2028, as the government shifts to the more secure Smart ID card.

item.title: Only 26.6% of young Brits have taken meningitis B vaccine as outbreaks kill three
item.description: Health officials warn that hundreds of thousands of eligible young people have not yet received the meningitis B vaccine despite three deaths from recent outbreaks and a one-off NHS vaccination programme launched this summer.

item.title: Trump adviser tells Canadian lobbyists to 'get the hell out' of U.S.
item.description: Peter Navarro, a trade adviser to President Trump, warned Canadian lobbyists on Tuesday to leave the U.S. and threatened repercussions if Canada interferes in upcoming midterm elections.

item.title: Luke Woodhouse stuns world number one Luke Littler at World Grand Prix
item.description: Defending champion Luke Littler suffered a 2-1 first-round loss to Luke Woodhouse on Monday at the 2026 World Grand Prix in Leicester.

item.title: Perth Police Snatch Power to Ban Protesters From Defence Expo Fort
item.description: Western Australian police are enforcing a strict security zone at next week's Land Forces expo, with letters already issued banning specific individuals from the site.

item.title: WhatsApp gives parents power to monitor teens' group activity and privacy settings
item.description: WhatsApp is rolling out optional parental controls that let guardians see when teenagers join or leave groups and decide privacy settings, though message content remains encrypted.

item.title: Piastri's brake lock-up in Azerbaijan drops him from podium to points-free horror
item.description: Oscar Piastri locked up on lap 40 of the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, plummeting from third place to 14th and out of the points in what he called a surprising moment that extended his difficult 2026 season.

item.title: Abdul Samad smashes 22 off five balls as Pakistan reach first Asian Games cricket final
item.description: Pakistan defeated Bangladesh by six wickets on October 1 to reach their maiden Asian Games cricket final, where they will face India on October 3 for the gold medal.

item.title: Danny Boyle backs Jack O'Connell for next James Bond role
item.description: Director Danny Boyle endorsed actor Jack O'Connell as the next James Bond during a masterclass at the Zurich Film Festival, praising his ability to make audiences root for morally complex characters.

item.title: Kenya Power imposes dumping surcharges on unauthorized residential solar energy grid connections
item.description: The Energy and Petroleum Regulatory Authority has introduced new fines for homes and businesses feeding excess solar electricity into the grid without approval.

item.title: Victorian scoops $1.2m TattsLotto win leaving the dentist
item.description: A Strathbogie Shire man in Victoria won $1,247,390.16 in TattsLotto draw 4715 on Saturday, September 26, after purchasing his ticket from Euroa News and Lotto, learning of his win when an official called while he was driving home from a dental appointment.

item.title: Code-hopper Nawaqanitawase plays final NRL match in Roosters grand final against Knights
item.description: Sydney Roosters winger Mark Nawaqanitawase will play his last rugby league game in Sunday's grand final against Newcastle Knights before returning to rugby union and the Wallabies.

item.title: Wike urges Nigeria to vote for leaders sustaining Abuja's infrastructure drive
item.description: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike called on Nigerians to elect progressive leaders in 2027 who will sustain infrastructure development in Abuja, describing the capital as a symbol of national unity.

item.title: DFI seizes full control of 1,100 Starbucks across Asia, exits Maxim's partnership
item.description: DFI Retail Group will take sole control of Starbucks operations across seven Asian markets—Singapore, Hong Kong, Macau, Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia and Laos—and receive US$340 million in cash by ending its 50-50 joint venture with Hongkong Caterers in Maxim's Caterers.

item.title: Japan and Ecuador Clash at Yokohama Stadium in 2026 Kirin Cup
item.description: Japan faces Ecuador in the 2026 Kirin Cup semifinal on October 1 at Nissan Stadium in Yokohama.

item.title: Central Texas braces for 4-6 inches of rain as flooding risk peaks Thursday
item.description: A Flood Watch covering most of Central Texas through Friday evening brings multiple rounds of storms with 2-4 inches of rain expected, rising to 4-6 inches in isolated areas, with the highest flooding risk on Thursday.

item.title: Suzuki beat Miller's slider for walk-off; Padres' closer eyes revenge in playoff rematch
item.description: Chicago Cubs outfielder Seiya Suzuki hit a walk-off single off San Diego Padres closer Mason Miller on a slider in June, but the two face off again Tuesday in the Wild Card Series with the Cubs' season at stake.
